parts.text: $OTEX: about 20¢ of every revenue dollar is operating profit, down from 22¢ a year ago. Q1 revenue $1.2B (-4% Y/Y). 👇 #earnings #tech
$FWONA: operating profit grew faster than sales, +50% vs +13% — Q3 revenue $1.2B, operating margin 19.3%. 👇 #earnings #media
$CTRI: operating profit grew faster than sales, +68% vs +40%. Q3 revenue $1.2B with a 5.1% operating margin. 👇 #earnings #utilities
$VSAT: product sales drove the top line while profit stayed thin — Q2 FY27 (preliminary) revenue $1.2B (+3% Y/Y) with a 0.6% operating margin. 👇 #earnings #media
$HUM Q3 2026 (preliminary): sold more but kept less — revenue rose 26% to $41.2B, but operating profit squeezed to a 0.2% margin. 👇 #earnings #insurance
$FLR: revenue grew 10% to $3.7B in Q3, while operating margin reached 6.0% and net earnings hit $158M. 👇 #earnings #industrials
$MAT: operating profit outpaced sales as Q3 revenue reached $1.8B (+4% Y/Y) with a 26.4% operating margin. 👇 #earnings #consumer
$ASTH: operating profit grew faster than sales, +108% vs +7%. Q3 revenue reached $1.0B with a 3.9% operating margin. 👇 #earnings #industrials
$ENB: revenue grew 44% but operating profit fell 6% — Q3 revenue $21.1B, operating margin 10.1%. Costs grew faster than sales. 👇 #earnings #industrials
$CHTR: revenue growth sped up to +9% from −2% but costs jumped 75%, leaving a $2.7B net loss in Q3. Revenue $14.9B. 👇 #earnings #media
$VST: operating profit grew faster than sales. Q3 2026 (preliminary) revenue reached $6.3B (+28% Y/Y) with a 26.9% operating margin. 👇 #earnings #utilities
$DK: profit is growing much faster than sales — revenue +52% to $4.4B, operating profit margin 34.6% (preliminary). Q3 net earnings reached $1.1B. 👇 #earnings #oil
